newsitem.title: NORWAY: Norway shares hit high on unchanged U.S. rates.
newsitem.headline: Norway shares hit high on unchanged U.S. rates.

text.p: The Norwegian stock exchange soared to a record close on Wednesday led by blue-chip companies after the U.S. Federal Reserve decided against raising interest rates the night before.
The Oslo bourse touched an intra-day peak of 1,142.04 points before closing at a record 1,140.67 points, up 1.64 percent from Tuesday.
Trade was brisk at around one billion crowns.
The previous all-time closing high of 1,128.46 was registered on February 20, or almost exactly three months ago.
Turnover in industrial group Kvaerner ASA amounted to nearly 130 million crowns, its A share rising 2.34 percent to 393 crowns.
Industrial conglomerate Norsk Hydro, Norway's largest listed company and with a 20 percent weighting on the Total index, jumped 2.57 percent to 359 crowns in turnover of 85 million crowns.
